summary: Tabs feature implemented in the repository but not executed: the instructions barred running tests or repository code, so all changes were verified by reading only. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity merges blended color into existing style, preserving meta; docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py, CHANGELOG Unreleased entry; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py, and new tests/test_tabs.py. Layout resolver unchanged because Edge already declares min_size. Deviations/choices: bar position uses displayed-tab index (matches the highlight definition; differs from find_tab_by_name only with duplicate names); Tabs sets can_focus = True so it receives keys. Known gaps: empty label width 0 takes flexible share; fixed-padding label row is not padded to full width; on_key is untested. Nothing committed. Run the test suite before merging.
